probes.check: The lifecycle probe checks that dear-imgui:CreateContext, a systems-phase step, runs after every earlier phase's steps.

seeded_violation.description: Create the ImGui context in am_bind_imgui_allocation(), in the memory phase.

adaptation_notes: ImGui::SetAllocatorFunctions sets globals for the module; call it before ImGui::CreateContext(). Across DLL boundaries each module installs its own (imgui.h).
The context belongs to the systems phase: creating it during memory setup runs it before SDL and the rest of the platform exist.
